ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
During the ripening process of banana fruit, the stored substances in the fruit are continuously metabolized and transformed, and the banana gradually becomes sweet. In Figure A, the two curves I and II respectively indicate the changing trends of the contents of two substances during the ripening process of banana fruit. Please answer:
Take equal amounts of banana pulp ripened to day X and day Y, and respectively add equal amounts of distilled water to make extracts. Then add 5 mL of the extract from day X to each of test tubes a and b, and add 5 mL of the extract from day Y to each of test tubes c and d, as shown in Figure B. After adding equal amounts of iodine solution to test tubes a and c, tube a appears blue. Compared with tube a, is the color of tube c deeper or lighter?

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: During the ripening process of banana fruit, the stored substances in the fruit are continuously metabolized and transformed, and the banana gradually becomes sweet. In Figure A, the two curves I and II respectively indicate the changing trends of the contents of two substances during the ripening process of banana fruit. Please answer: Take equal amounts of banana pulp ripened to day X and day Y, and respectively add equal amounts of distilled water to make extracts. Then add 5 mL of the extract from day X to each of test tubes a and b, and add 5 mL of the extract from day Y to each of test tubes c and d, as shown in Figure B. After adding equal amounts of iodine solution to test tubes a and c, tube a appears blue. Compared with tube a, is the color of tube c deeper or lighter?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In Figure A, the horizontal axis indicates ripening time, X is located at an earlier time position, and Y is located at a later time position; curve I decreases as ripening time increases, and curve II increases as ripening time increases. In Figure B, test tubes a and b are labeled as the extract from day X, and test tubes c and d are labeled as the extract from day Y; above test tubes a and c it is labeled that iodine solution is added. Then reason: The question stem states that during the ripening process of banana the banana gradually becomes sweet, indicating that the stored starch is gradually transformed into sugar, so curve I, whose content decreases, represents starch, and curve II, whose content increases, represents sugar. Day Y is later in ripening than day X, so the starch content in the extract from day Y is lower than that from day X. Iodine solution turns blue when it meets starch, and the more starch there is, the deeper the blue color. After tube a is added with the extract from day X and iodine solution, it appears blue; tube c is added with the extract from day Y and iodine solution, and because there is less starch, compared with tube a its color is lighter.
